purpose: Phase-8A resistance evidence records. CRITICAL: the frozen package contains NO direct drug-resistance dataset for this tripterine-NLC context - no longitudinal exposure, washout, rechallenge, IC50 shift, fold-resistance, time-to-resistance, or resistant-cell count. The single verified primary study (Chen 2012) measured tumour RESPONSE / formulation ranking, NOT resistance, so every resistance-specific endpoint below is NOT_REPORTED. Resistance relationships are therefore LABELLED PREDICTIONS (general tumour drug-resistance biology), never experimental facts. Each record preserves the distinction between measured finding, author interpretation, simulator interpretation, and model prediction.

re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.title: Preparation of a tripterine (celastrol) nanostructured lipid carrier and its antimelanoma activity
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.authors: Chen Y, Zhou L, Yuan L, Zhang Z-h, Liu X, Wu Q
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.citation: Chen Y, et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033. doi:10.2147/IJN.S32476 (PMC3392146)
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.treatment_schedule: NOT_REPORTED (resistance-relevant longitudinal schedule not the focus of this study)
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.baseline_response: in vivo antimelanoma response present (direction only); cationic NLC > anionic/neutral, NLC > free (ranking direction)
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.post_exposure_response: NOT_REPORTED (no longitudinal resistance follow-up in this study)
supports: existence of an active tripterine-NLC B16BL6 treatment context (anchors baseline sensitivity DIRECTION and formulation ranking)
does_not_support: any resistance emergence / tolerance / adaptation / acquired resistance
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.limitations: Measures tumour response and formulation ranking, NOT resistance; used only to anchor the baseline context, never to claim a resistance finding.
re_b16bl6_context_chen2012.notes: measured_finding = antimelanoma direction + ranking; simulator_interpretation = baseline context anchor only; NO resistance conclusion is attributed to this study.

re_b16bl6_baseline.title: General melanoma drug-resistance biology (mechanistic prediction basis)
re_b16bl6_baseline.citation: NOT_REPORTED (general tumour drug-resistance biology applied predictively; no direct B16BL6 tripterine-NLC resistance dataset in the frozen package)
re_b16bl6_baseline.baseline_response: predicted moderate baseline sensitivity with minor intrinsic heterogeneity (schematic)
re_b16bl6_baseline.post_exposure_response: predicted potential for reversible tolerance / adaptive resistance under sustained pressure (labelled prediction)
supports: schematic baseline heterogeneity + qualitative resistance TENDENCIES (labelled prediction)
re_b16bl6_baseline.limitations: Entirely predictive; grounds direction of tendencies only.
re_b16bl6_baseline.notes: model_prediction (general biology); explicitly NOT an experimental finding.

re_human_baseline.title: Predictive-exploratory human melanoma resistance context (mechanistic prediction basis)
re_human_baseline.citation: NOT_REPORTED (predictive human context with own distinct states; not validated)
re_human_baseline.baseline_response: predicted heterogeneous baseline sensitivity (exploratory; own distinct values, not copied from mouse)
supports: exploratory human baseline heterogeneity (labelled prediction, distinct from mouse)
re_human_baseline.limitations: Predictive-exploratory; not validated; not shown by default.
re_human_baseline.notes: model_prediction; carries a mandated non-clinical warning.

integrity_rules.no_experimental_resistance_tier: No record asserts an experimental resistance finding; there is no experimental resistance tier for this context.
integrity_rules.chen2012_is_context_anchor_only: Chen 2012 anchors the treatment context / baseline direction / formulation ranking ONLY; it is never cited as evidence of resistance, washout, or rechallenge behaviour.
integrity_rules.no_fabricated_quantities: No IC50 / fold-resistance / time-to-resistance / resistant-cell count / mutation is stated (all NOT_REPORTED).
integrity_rules.distinction_preserved: Each record separates measured finding / author interpretation / simulator interpretation / model prediction.
integrity_rules.no_silent_transfer: Species / model / formulation records are isolated; any transfer requires an explicit labelled prediction in resistance-prediction.registry.json.
